notes.title: Wings! Remastered Edition - Update Available!
notes.content:
An update addressing some reported issues with the game has just been released. Here are the major changes:

- Added support for older joystick control assignments and throttle axis
- Adjusted font size of first newspaper headline (English language version)
- Improved plane AI in dogfight modes
- Fixed mission 203 bombing targets
- Performance improvements

You will automatically receive the update via your Steam client, just make sure you have automatic updates enabled.
